Health connect/sync action disappears on an empty Today page

Use an account with a goal and no meals or workouts on the selected current day. Open Today and look for the contextual Apple Health or Health Connect action. Open Settings > Health to confirm the integration remains reachable there.
A new or returning user can connect or sync health from the empty current-day state, before manually logging a meal or workout.

Today renders only Start today, Add food, and Add workout. The health action is nested inside the day-list section and is therefore absent until the day has a meal or workout; Settings > Health remains reachable.
/Users/mason/Sites/Buff/resources/js/Pages/Today.vue:683-689 renders the empty state while the contextual health controls at :770-796 are inside showDayLists.
Show the health connect/sync action in the empty Today state as well as populated days.
Android reproduced with an already-connected Health Connect account (missing Sync action). The disconnected Connect variant and iOS remain to be exercised.
Android release bundle packages an unreachable public/hot URL

Build/package the Android release while the root Vite dev server has public/hot. Inspect laravel_bundle.zip inside the AAB, then resolve the embedded https://Buff.test:5173 host from the Android emulator.
A release bundle resolves all frontend assets from the packaged public/build manifest.

The verified AAB embeds public/hot=https://Buff.test:5173. The Android emulator reports Buff.test as an unknown host, so Laravel Vite emits unreachable hot-server asset URLs instead of packaged assets.
The NativePHP bundle copy includes root public/hot when a separate web Vite dev server is active; the release packaging path does not remove the generic hot marker before archiving.
Exclude public/hot from NativePHP bundles so an unrelated web development server cannot break packaged startup.

Signed Android build24 AAB excludes public/hot. Matching signed APK has identical contents across all18068 bundled entries and starts to a styled Sign in screen on clean API36.1 emulator5556. Existing QA data preserved; no upload.
The in-place Android debug build used for initial behavior testing predates this AAB and loads packaged assets correctly.
Android release versionCode is one build behind the canonical app configuration
Compare NATIVEPHP_APP_VERSION_CODE in the root and bundled environment with versionCode in the generated Android Gradle file and merged AAB manifest.
The packaged Android artifact uses versionCode 14, matching the canonical NativePHP configuration and bundled metadata.
Root and bundled environment report build 14, but nativephp/android/app/build.gradle.kts and the verified AAB manifest report versionCode 13.
Generated Android project metadata was not synchronized to the current NativePHP version code before packaging.
Synchronize generated Android Gradle, bundle metadata and .version from the freshly bundled environment in the existing post-compile hook; preserve DEBUG and retained-bundle identity.
NativePluginHooksTest8/8,152 assertions; signed AAB/APK manifest and bundled environment both1.0.0/code24. Full PHP409/409; frontend228/228; TypeScript/Pint/diff pass.

Package and actual signed native startup agree at1.0.0/code24; signing verification passes. Canonical configuration, generated Gradle, .version and bundle metadata were verified against prepared bundle. No store upload.
This can produce incorrect Play Store update identity even though compilation and signing succeed.
Registration keyboard Return bypasses disabled step validation
Open Create account. Focus the blank name field and press the keyboard Return/Next action; then continue with email, enter malformed text such as qa, and press Return again.
Keyboard Return follows the same validation as the disabled Next button: blank name and malformed email remain on their current steps.
Return advances from blank name to method and from malformed email to password even though Next is visibly disabled.
/Users/mason/Sites/Buff/resources/js/Pages/Account.vue binds @keyup.enter directly to nextRegisterStep for name/email/password, while nextRegisterStep does not enforce registrationNextDisabled.
Route keyboard Return and button advancement through the same registration validation guard.
Shared validation fix verified on iOS and Android build 15. Blank name, malformed email and short password cannot advance using Return.

iOS evidence: retest/ios/ACC-004-blank-name-return-guard.png and ACC-004-malformed-email-return-guard.png. Android evidence: retest/android/ACC-004-empty-return.json, ACC-004-invalid-email-return.json and ACC-004-short-password-return.json. Valid values advance.
Four-step registration progress is calculated as fourteen steps
Open Create account and advance through name, method, email, and password while observing the progress bar.
The four registration steps report approximately 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% completion.
The bar reports approximately 7%, 14%, 21%, and 29%, so the final password step still appears less than one-third complete.
/Users/mason/Sites/Buff/resources/js/Pages/Account.vue calculates registrationProgress by dividing the current four-step index by 14.
Calculate progress from the actual four registration steps.
iOS build15: observed accessible progress25/50/75/100 across all four registration steps. Evidence: retest/ios/ACC-004-final-progress-100.png and ACC-004-method-progress-50.png.
Selecting the already-selected date leaves the calendar open
Select a historical Today date. Reopen Select date, navigate to that month, and tap the same selected day.
The picker closes without issuing another visit or changing browser history.
The URL and history remain unchanged, but the calendar popover stays open after the same date is tapped.

/Users/mason/Sites/Buff/resources/js/Pages/Today.vue closes the popover only from @update:model-value. The calendar emits no model update when the chosen value is unchanged, so selectDate never receives the close callback.
Emit the selected-day click separately so choosing the current value still closes the date popover.
Different-date selection still closes and preserves the dated Today route correctly.
Cancelled recipe drafts retain auxiliary search and custom ingredient fields
Open Recipes > Create your first recipe. Enter a recipe name and servings, a one-character food search, and an unadded custom ingredient. Tap Cancel, then reopen recipe creation.
Cancel returns to the recipe list without a request, and reopening starts with a blank name, servings 1, no items, blank food search, blank custom ingredient fields, and Save disabled.

Cancel sent no recipe request and reset the recipe name, servings, and item list, but the food search and unadded custom ingredient values persisted. Add ingredient was immediately enabled on the reopened blank recipe.

/Users/mason/Sites/Buff/resources/js/Components/RecipeMode.vue startCreate resets only recipeForm.name, recipeForm.servings, and recipeForm.items; it does not clear searchQuery, searchResults, customItem, or prior form errors.
Reset abandoned recipe values, custom ingredient fields, search results, debounce work and errors when opening an editor.

Build16 native regression passed on both platforms. Cancel resets the abandoned recipe and auxiliary editor state in create and saved-recipe edit flows. Reopening restores clean defaults or the original saved recipe. Full NUT-044 remains incomplete for delayed search and additional error branches.

Original failure was observed on Android in the shared Vue component without a POST /recipes request. Build 15 retest now passes that specific stale auxiliary draft case: recipe name, servings 2, an unsaved appended ingredient, search a and an unadded custom name were discarded by Cancel without any recipe request; reopening showed blank names/search, no items, servings 1, quantity 100, all macros 0 and Save disabled. Evidence: retest/android/NUT-044-before-cancel.json, NUT-044-cancel-no-recipe.json, NUT-044-reopen-cleared.json and NUT-044-reopen-cleared.png. From a dated Today page, open /add?mode=custom&date=not-a-date.
The request returns safely and visibly explains that the date is invalid.
The app redirected to the referring dated Today page with a date validation error in Inertia page props, but rendered no alert or explanation.
The shared validation error reaches the redirected Inertia page, but the Today/Add surfaces do not render the date error or a global validation summary.
Render shared date validation feedback on Today after rejected deep-link navigation.
The invalid date was rejected and no data write occurred; only the user-facing feedback is missing.
Invalid meal deep links produce an invisible form error
Open /add?mode=custom&meal=nonsense&date=2026-09-02. Enter an otherwise-valid custom food and submit it.
The invalid meal context is rejected or normalized before form entry, or the failed submission visibly identifies the invalid meal selection.
The heading displayed Custom food — Nonsense and no meal option was selected. The POST returned meal_type: The selected meal type is invalid, but the form rendered no alert and appeared unchanged.

/Users/mason/Sites/Buff/app/Http/Controllers/MealController.php passes arbitrary meal query values into Add.vue. /Users/mason/Sites/Buff/resources/js/Pages/Add.vue renders the value in the heading and submits it, but the custom form has no meal_type error element.
Normalize invalid meal query values at the Add controller boundary and expose form meal errors.
The deliberately invalid POST created no meal. The server validation worked; the user cannot see or resolve it without selecting another meal type.
Weekly roundup never shows which row is the selected Today date
Open a dated Today page and follow Weekly roundup. Compare the selectedDate/week is_selected response values with the seven rendered daily rows.
The originating date is visibly distinguished within its Monday-Sunday week.
Exactly one response row was marked is_selected=true for every tested date, but none of the daily rows had selected text, state, or styling.
/Users/mason/Sites/Buff/resources/js/Pages/Weekly.vue defines WeekDay.is_selected but the daily-row template never reads it.
Render the selected weekly row with a visible state and programmatic current-date semantics.

The server selection and Back target were correct; this is a presentation-only gap.

iOS build 15: Weekly opened from Sep 3 renders exactly one aria-current=date row with a visible selected background. Evidence: NUT-096-102-105-daily-rows.png and batch 007 observations. Other NUT096 date branches remain partial.
Weekly calendar cannot reliably navigate beyond the displayed month
Open a clean /weekly?date=2026-10-15 URL, open Week containing, and press Next. Also open the year selector.
Next advances the month on every press, and the native month/year selectors open on the displayed October 2026 values.
Two trusted Next presses left the clean calendar on October 2026. Both native selects had selectedIndex -1, and opening the year selector started at 1926 with no checked current year.

The original navigation placeholder ignored the selected model date; that initialization was already fixed. The remaining native-selector failure has the same displayed-date/state mismatch at another layer: Calendar.vue only set selected attributes on options, while NativeSelect.vue binds its select to useVModel with an empty-string default. Vue 3.5.42 treats v-model as authoritative and clears option selection when that value matches no option, producing selectedIndex -1 while the separate visual overlay still displays October/2026. The iOS build 15 observation confirms Next now advances September to October but both native selectors remain unselected.

Preserve the existing model-derived navigation placeholder fix. Pass the displayed date.month and date.year to the respective NativeSelect model-value props, and remove redundant per-option selected attributes. Existing change handlers still update the calendar placeholder; arrows, date selection, year range, native-select internals and Weekly layout are unchanged. Today and Weekly are the two current shared-calendar callers and both use month-and-year layout.
